11-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (79-bet) - YoZUV, O'QISh va TINGLASh.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Write a short paragraph about what you would do to protect the environment if you were the leader of your country. Use the texts in Ex. 5 as models.'
• To'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
14) a) 'Look at picture A. What is the girl doing? What other things do we use water for in our daily lives?' b) 'Look at picture B. Is the water clean? Who/What do you think is polluting it?' c) 'From the list below, tick the three most important things we can do to save our planet's water supplies, then make sentences as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: 'We CAN save the water from our baths and use it for the garden.' 1 save water from our baths and use it for the garden; 2 pass laws to stop factories from wasting and polluting water; 3 recycle water; 4 stop factories from pouring chemicals into lakes and rivers; 5 repair leaking pipes.
15) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and correct the words in bold.' 1 We all need water - not just for our GARDENS and factories, but to survive. 2 The PROBLEM begins at home. 3 Governments can help by passing laws to stop ANIMALS from wasting and polluting water. 4 Many cities have successfully WASTED water by repairing pipes.
16) a) 'Read the article and circle the correct answer for items 1 to 4.' b) 'What is the problem discussed? Which paragraphs include the writer's suggestions? What are these suggestions? What results/examples does the writer use to support his suggestions?'

O'NG TOMON - OCh YaShIL MATN, sarlavha oq 'Water, Water Everywhere ...'. SURATLAR: A - qizcha shlang bilan gullarni sug'ormoqda; B - quvurdan iflos suv daryoga oqmoqda.
1-XATBOShI (yashil raqam): 'Imagine a world with no drinking water, and no water to wash or cook with. It's hard to imagine this, because we use water every day without even thinking about it. Yet there are terrible water shortages all over the world. In parts of Africa and China, for example, many people don't even have clean water to drink. In fact, over half of the people in the world have to live with water shortages every day. We all need water - not just for our homes and factories, but to survive. Fortunately, there are things that we can all do to save water.'
2: 'The solution begins at home. We can save the water from our baths and use it for the garden, instead of wasting hundreds of litres of clean water on our lawns and plants. This would help to save many litres of water everyday, especially in the summer.'
3: 'Governments can help by passing laws to stop factories from wasting and polluting water. If factories recycled water and stopped pouring chemicals into our lakes and rivers, there would be a lot more clean water around.'
4: 'Governments could also stop water companies from wasting millions of litres of water because of leaking pipes. Many cities have successfully saved water by repairing pipes.'
5: 'All in all, there are many things we can do to save our planet's disappearing water supplies. The time has come to start understanding the value of water, before a world without clean water becomes a terrible reality.'

Matn ostida test: 1 The writer says that in many parts of the world people ... a don't have water at all. b don't have any clean water. c have too much water. 2 The writer suggests that we should ... a use more water at home. b stop using water at home. c stop using so much water at home. 3 There would be more clean water around if factories ... a produced more water. b used the same water several times. c only used water from rivers and lakes. 4 Water companies can help ... a by fixing pipes. b by giving us more water. c by making people pay a lot more.

• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article in Ex. 16 again and make notes under the headings below, then talk about what we can do to save water.' Ko'k qiya: 'Suggestions - Results/Examples'.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '79'.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a short paragraph about what you would do to protect the environment if you were the leader of your country. Use the texts in Ex. 5 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Agar mamlakatingiz rahbari bo'lsangiz, atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun nima qilishingiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing. 5-mashqdagi matnlardan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 2-TUR ShART GAPI bilan yozing:
  'If I were the leader of my
   country, I would ...'


QOLIP (77-betdagi matnlar kabi):

  1 If I were ..., I would (chora).
  2 Nima uchun (muammo).
  3 If they did, ... would ...
    (natija).


⚠ 'TO PROTECT':

  = himoya qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'protection' = himoya.


⚠ 'A PARAGRAPH':

  = xatboshi (abzats).

structure.modelEn: If I were the leader of my country, I would stop factories from pouring chemicals into rivers and lakes.
structure.modelUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, zavodlarning daryo va ko'llarga kimyoviy moddalar quyishini to'xtatardim.

structure.modelEn: Many rivers are very dirty and fish are dying.
structure.modelUz: Ko'p daryolar juda iflos va baliqlar o'lmoqda.

structure.modelEn: If factories recycled their water, our rivers would be clean again.
structure.modelUz: Agar zavodlar suvni qayta ishlasa, daryolarimiz yana toza bo'lardi.

modelAnswers: If I were the leader of my country, I would stop factories from pouring chemicals into rivers and lakes. Many rivers are very dirty and fish are dying. If factories recycled their water, our rivers would be clean again and people would have clean drinking water.
modelAnswersUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, zavodlarning daryo va ko'llarga kimyoviy moddalar quyishini to'xtatardim. Ko'p daryolar juda iflos va baliqlar o'lmoqda. Agar zavodlar suvni qayta ishlasa, daryolarimiz yana toza bo'lardi va odamlarda toza ichimlik suvi bo'lardi.

items.en: a) Look at picture A. What is the girl doing?

items.answerEn: The girl is watering the flowers with a hose.

items.answerEn: We use water for drinking, cooking, washing, cleaning, having a bath or shower and washing clothes.

exercises.instructionEn: From the list below, tick the three most important things we can do to save our planet's water supplies, then make sentences as in the example. 1 save water from our baths and use it for the garden 2 pass laws to stop factories from wasting and polluting water 3 recycle water 4 stop factories from pouring chemicals into lakes and rivers 5 repair leaking pipes
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdan sayyoramiz suv zaxiralarini saqlash uchun qilishimiz mumkin bo'lgan eng muhim uchta narsani belgilang, keyin namunadagidek gaplar tuzing. 1 vannadagi suvni saqlab bog' uchun ishlatish 2 zavodlarning suvni isrof qilishi va ifloslantirishini to'xtatuvchi qonunlar qabul qilish 3 suvni qayta ishlash 4 zavodlarning ko'l va daryolarga kimyoviy moddalar quyishini to'xtatish 5 oqayotgan quvurlarni ta'mirlash
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'We CAN save the water from our
   baths and use it for the garden.'

  ⚠ QOLIP: We can + FE'L.
  ⚠ Uchtasini tanlang - o'z fikringiz.


⚠ 'WATER SUPPLIES':

  = suv zaxiralari.
  ⚠ 'supply' = ta'minot, zaxira.


⚠ 'TO PASS A LAW':

  = qonun qabul qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'law' = qonun.


⚠ 'TO WASTE':

  = isrof qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'waste' (ot) = chiqindi.


⚠ 'TO POUR':

  = quymoq.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /pɔː/.


⚠ 'CHEMICALS':

  = kimyoviy moddalar.


⚠ 'TO LEAK':

  = oqmoq (teshikdan).
  ⚠ 'leaking pipes' = oqayotgan
  quvurlar.


⚠ 'TO REPAIR':

  = ta'mirlamoq.
  = 'to fix'.

items.textEn: 3 Governments can help by passing laws to stop ___ (animals) from wasting and polluting water.
4 Many cities have successfully ___ (wasted) water by repairing pipes.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Ichimlik suvi bo'lmagan, yuvinish
va ovqat pishirish uchun suv bo'lmagan
dunyoni tasavvur qiling. Buni
tasavvur qilish qiyin, chunki biz
suvni har kuni hatto o'ylamasdan
ishlatamiz. Lekin butun dunyoda
dahshatli suv tanqisligi bor.
Masalan, Afrika va Xitoyning ba'zi
qismlarida ko'p odamlarda hatto
ichish uchun toza suv yo'q. Aslida,
dunyodagi odamlarning yarmidan
ko'pi har kuni suv tanqisligi bilan
yashashga majbur. Hammamizga suv
kerak - faqat uylarimiz va
zavodlarimiz uchun emas, balki omon
qolish uchun. Baxtimizga, suvni
tejash uchun hammamiz qila oladigan
ishlar bor.

2) Yechim uydan boshlanadi. Biz
vannadagi suvni saqlab bog' uchun
ishlatishimiz mumkin - maysazor va
o'simliklarga yuzlab litr toza suvni
isrof qilish o'rniga. Bu har kuni,
ayniqsa yozda, ko'p litr suvni
tejashga yordam berardi.

3) Hukumatlar zavodlarning suvni
isrof qilishi va ifloslantirishini
to'xtatuvchi qonunlar qabul qilib
yordam bera oladi. Agar zavodlar
suvni qayta ishlasa va ko'l va
daryolarimizga kimyoviy moddalar
quyishni to'xtatsa, atrofda ancha
ko'proq toza suv bo'lardi.

4) Hukumatlar suv kompaniyalarining
oqayotgan quvurlar tufayli
millionlab litr suvni isrof
qilishini ham to'xtata olardi. Ko'p
shaharlar quvurlarni ta'mirlab
suvni muvaffaqiyatli tejagan.

5) Umuman olganda, sayyoramizning
yo'qolib borayotgan suv zaxiralarini
saqlash uchun qila oladigan ko'p
ishlarimiz bor. Toza suvsiz dunyo
dahshatli haqiqatga aylanishidan
oldin suvning qadrini tushunishni
boshlash vaqti keldi.


⚠ 'A SHORTAGE':

  = tanqislik, yetishmovchilik.
  ⚠ 'water shortages' = suv
  tanqisligi.
  ⚠ 'short' = qisqa, kam.


⚠ 'YET':

  = lekin, ammo (gap boshida).
  ⚠ Bu yerda 'hali' EMAS!


⚠ 'OVER HALF':

  = yarmidan ko'pi.
  ⚠ 'over' = ...dan ko'p.


⚠ 'FORTUNATELY':

  = baxtimizga.
  ⚠ 'unfortunately' = afsuski.


⚠ 'INSTEAD OF + -ING':

  = ... o'rniga.
  'instead of WASTING' - fe'l -ING
  bilan!


⚠ 'A LAWN':

  = maysazor.


⚠ 'A GOVERNMENT':

  = hukumat.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈɡʌvənmənt/ - birinchi
  'n' deyarli eshitilmaydi.


⚠ 'ALL IN ALL':

  = umuman olganda (xulosa).


⚠ 'THE TIME HAS COME':

  = vaqti keldi.


⚠ 'VALUE':

  = qadr, qiymat.


⚠ 'REALITY':

  = haqiqat, voqelik.
  ⚠ 'real' = haqiqiy.

points.en: Imagine a world with no drinking water, and no water to wash or cook with. It's hard to imagine this, because we use water every day without even thinking about it.
points.uz: Ichimlik suvi bo'lmagan, yuvinish va ovqat pishirish uchun suv bo'lmagan dunyoni tasavvur qiling. Buni tasavvur qilish qiyin, chunki biz suvni har kuni hatto o'ylamasdan ishlatamiz.

points.en: Yet there are terrible water shortages all over the world. In parts of Africa and China, for example, many people don't even have clean water to drink.
points.uz: Lekin butun dunyoda dahshatli suv tanqisligi bor. Masalan, Afrika va Xitoyning ba'zi qismlarida ko'p odamlarda hatto ichish uchun toza suv yo'q.

points.en: In fact, over half of the people in the world have to live with water shortages every day. We all need water - not just for our homes and factories, but to survive. Fortunately, there are things that we can all do to save water.
points.uz: Aslida, dunyodagi odamlarning yarmidan ko'pi har kuni suv tanqisligi bilan yashashga majbur. Hammamizga suv kerak - faqat uylarimiz va zavodlarimiz uchun emas, balki omon qolish uchun. Baxtimizga, suvni tejash uchun hammamiz qila oladigan ishlar bor.

points.en: The solution begins at home. We can save the water from our baths and use it for the garden, instead of wasting hundreds of litres of clean water on our lawns and plants. This would help to save many litres of water everyday, especially in the summer.
points.uz: Yechim uydan boshlanadi. Biz vannadagi suvni saqlab bog' uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin - maysazor va o'simliklarga yuzlab litr toza suvni isrof qilish o'rniga. Bu har kuni, ayniqsa yozda, ko'p litr suvni tejashga yordam berardi.

points.en: Governments can help by passing laws to stop factories from wasting and polluting water. If factories recycled water and stopped pouring chemicals into our lakes and rivers, there would be a lot more clean water around.
points.uz: Hukumatlar zavodlarning suvni isrof qilishi va ifloslantirishini to'xtatuvchi qonunlar qabul qilib yordam bera oladi. Agar zavodlar suvni qayta ishlasa va ko'l va daryolarimizga kimyoviy moddalar quyishni to'xtatsa, atrofda ancha ko'proq toza suv bo'lardi.
points.noteUz: ⚠ 2-tur shart gapi: 'If ... recycled ..., there would be'.

points.en: Governments could also stop water companies from wasting millions of litres of water because of leaking pipes. Many cities have successfully saved water by repairing pipes.
points.uz: Hukumatlar suv kompaniyalarining oqayotgan quvurlar tufayli millionlab litr suvni isrof qilishini ham to'xtata olardi. Ko'p shaharlar quvurlarni ta'mirlab suvni muvaffaqiyatli tejagan.

points.en: All in all, there are many things we can do to save our planet's disappearing water supplies. The time has come to start understanding the value of water, before a world without clean water becomes a terrible reality.
points.uz: Umuman olganda, sayyoramizning yo'qolib borayotgan suv zaxiralarini saqlash uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor. Toza suvsiz dunyo dahshatli haqiqatga aylanishidan oldin suvning qadrini tushunishni boshlash vaqti keldi.

exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va 1-4 bandlar uchun to'g'ri javobni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 b - don't have any clean water
    ('many people don't even have
     clean water to drink')

    hundreds of litres')

  = bir nechta.

  = ta'mirlamoq.
